verdict.rationale: Recurly's developer API page lists official client libraries for Ruby, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, PHP and Go, plus native Android/iOS mobile SDKs and a JavaScript SDK for Engage. Community threads corroborate real use of the Recurly.js client library, though one notes a jQuery dependency. Missing for 10: in-depth per-SDK documentation (versioning, typed models, maintenance status) beyond a library list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server-side SDKs.
